sql_templates.purpose: Retrieve latest EOD stocks with breakout, VCP, and strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_eod AS (
                SELECT symbol, high, close, volume, market_cap_cr
                FROM market.equity_eod
                WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
            ),
            latest_stage AS (
                SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal, enhanced_fund_score
                FROM scores.stage_snapshots
                WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
                AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
                AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
            ),
            vcp_candidates AS (
                SELECT symbol, vcp_score
                FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks
                WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
                ORDER BY vcp_score DESC
                LIMIT 20
            )
            SELECT e.symbol, e.high, e.close, e.volume, e.market_cap_cr, s.stage, s.trading_signal, s.enhanced_fund_score, v.vcp_score
            FROM latest_eod e
            JOIN latest_stage s ON e.symbol = s.symbol
            JOIN vcp_candidates v ON e.symbol = v.symbol
            ORDER BY v.vcp_score DESC, s.enhanced_fund_score DESC
            LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: Ensure candidates exhibit strong VCP characteristics with supportive fundamentals.
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 0618

sql_templates.description: Ranks sectors by breadth and Stage 2 participation over the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: sector_rankings
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM breadth.sector_daily), 
ranked_sectors AS (
    SELECT sd.sector,
           AVG(sd.pct_above_50dma::numeric) as avg_50dma,
           AVG(mpa.stage2_pct) as avg_stage2,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(sd.pct_above_50dma::numeric) DESC) AS dma_rank,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(mpa.stage2_pct) DESC) AS stage2_rank
    FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above mpa ON sd.snapshot_date = mpa.snapshot_date
    WHERE sd.snapshot_date BETWEEN latest_snapshots.latest_date - INTERVAL '4 days' AND latest_snapshots.latest_date
    GROUP BY sd.sector
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_sectors
ORDER BY dma_rank, stage2_rank
LIMIT 10;
